item.title: THIS GUY Films the Unexplained & Real UFO Encounters (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Tim Seanor is a UFO researcher, filmmaker, producer, and investigator dedicated to documenting eyewitness accounts of unidentified flying objects and unexplained aerial phenomena. With a background in film production, directing, and broadcasting, Seanor has worked on projects including Last Call, Encounter: UFO, and Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction. His research focuses on firsthand UFO encounters, field investigations, and the challenges of capturing unexplained phenomena on camera. Seanor has appeared on numerous podcasts and radio programs, including Spaced Out Radio and Podcast UFO, sharing his investigations into mysterious sightings, including reported encounters on Bainbridge Island, Washington, in 2019 and British Columbia's Cariboo Region in 2023. Through his filmmaking and investigative work, Seanor continues to explore the UFO phenomenon, seeking to document compelling eyewitness testimony and unusual events that challenge conventional explanations.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
